text: sentry_list_organizations with a valid X-Sentry-Auth-Token returns the token's accessible organizations with id/slug/name.
steps: Set X-Sentry-Auth-Token to a valid Sentry Auth Token
Call sentry_list_organizations with no arguments
expect: Result is a JSON object with an organizations list; each entry has id, slug and name fields.

text: Any tool call without X-Sentry-Auth-Token returns HTTP 401 with required_headers listing X-Sentry-Auth-Token.
sentry_list_projects for a known organization slug returns that org's projects with id/slug/name/platform.
steps: Call sentry_list_projects with a known organization_slug
expect: Result's projects list contains the known project(s), each with id, slug, name and platform.

text: sentry_get_project for a known org+project slug returns project detail including teams and dateCreated.
steps: Call sentry_get_project with a known organization_slug and project_slug
expect: Result includes id, slug, name, platform, teams and dateCreated for that project.

text: sentry_list_issues with no query returns only unresolved issues (Sentry's default is:unresolved).
steps: Call sentry_list_issues with a known organization_slug and no query argument
expect: Every issue in the result has status unresolved.

text: sentry_list_issues with query="" returns issues regardless of status, not just unresolved.
steps: Call sentry_list_issues with a known organization_slug and query set to an empty string
Compare against a known resolved issue in that project
expect: The known resolved issue appears in the result even though its status is not unresolved.

text: sentry_get_issue on a known issue id returns title/status/level/firstSeen/lastSeen/assignedTo.
steps: Call sentry_get_issue with a known organization_slug and issue_id
expect: Result includes title, status, level, firstSeen, lastSeen and assignedTo fields matching the known issue.

text: sentry_update_issue(status="resolved") on an unresolved issue changes its status to resolved.
steps: Call sentry_update_issue with a known unresolved issue_id and status set to resolved
Call sentry_get_issue on the same issue_id
expect: The follow-up sentry_get_issue shows status resolved.

text: sentry_update_issue(assigned_to=<member>) sets assignedTo on an issue without changing its status.
steps: Note the current status of a known issue via sentry_get_issue
Call sentry_update_issue with that issue_id and assigned_to set to a known organization member
Call sentry_get_issue again on the same issue_id
expect: assignedTo now matches the given member; status is unchanged from the first sentry_get_issue call.

text: sentry_list_issue_events on an issue with multiple events returns those events with eventID/dateCreated.
steps: Call sentry_list_issue_events with a known organization_slug and issue_id that has more than one event
expect: Result's events list has more than one entry, each with eventID and dateCreated.

text: sentry_get_issue_event on a known issue+event id returns entries with exception/stacktrace data and a tags list.
steps: Call sentry_get_issue_event with a known organization_slug, issue_id and event_id
expect: Result includes an entries array containing exception/stacktrace data, and a tags list.

text: sentry_list_members for a known organization returns members with email/orgRole/pending.
steps: Call sentry_list_members with a known organization_slug
expect: Result's members list contains at least one entry with email, orgRole and pending fields.

text: sentry_list_releases for a known organization returns releases with version/dateCreated.
steps: Call sentry_list_releases with a known organization_slug
expect: Result's releases list contains at least one entry with version and dateCreated.

text: sentry_get_release on a known version returns release detail including newGroups/commitCount.
steps: Call sentry_get_release with a known organization_slug and version
expect: Result includes version, projects, newGroups and commitCount.

text: sentry_create_release(version="test-v1", projects=[...]) creates a new release returned with the given version.
steps: Call sentry_create_release with a new, not-yet-used version string and a known project slug
expect: Result is the created release object with version equal to the given string.

text: Calling sentry_create_release again with the same version returns the existing release rather than an error.
steps: Call sentry_create_release a second time with the same version and projects used in TC-SENTRY-015
expect: Call succeeds (no error envelope) and returns a release with the same id as the one created in TC-SENTRY-015.

text: sentry_create_deploy(version=<existing release>, environment="production") creates a deploy record returned with that environment.
steps: Call sentry_create_deploy with the version from TC-SENTRY-015 and environment set to production
expect: Result is the created deploy object with environment equal to production.

text: _STATUS_TO_CODE maps 400/401/403/404/409/429/500/network-timeout to the documented error codes and retryable flags; none raise past run_tool.
A real call against a deliberately invalid issue id returns not_found via the structured envelope, not an exception.
steps: Call sentry_get_issue with a known organization_slug and an issue_id that does not exist
expect: Result is the structured error envelope with code not_found; no exception/traceback is surfaced.
